name: 6 Undead + Dragon / Harpy
description: A snowball board that plagues both teams for -40% max health, then out-damages everyone with Lich, Necrophos and Spectre while Wraith King revives the dead. Dragons give instant casts and 2 Harpies multiply single-target spells. Built off the Ascetics Cap round-3 tech. Sourced from the YouTube guide 'HOW TO PLAY The Strongest 6 Undead Build In Auto Chess'.

snapshots.label: Final board
snapshots.focusNote: 6 different Undead halve enemy health (-40% plague); 3 Dragons + Winter Wyvern feed 100 starting mana for near-instant Lich/Necrophos casts; Vengeful Spirit + Skywrath Mage give 2 Harpy so those single-target nukes hit an extra target. Wraith King revives fallen undead for a second fight.
